gold: Diffuse large B-cell lymphoma of the central nervous system

selector.rationale: The presence of a 30-mm mass lesion in the right temporal lobe, as revealed by CT and MRI of the head, strongly supports brain metastasis, especially given the patient's history of stage IV breast cancer and the fact that the cancer had spread to other parts of the body.

rejected.label: Trastuzumab-related neurotoxicity
rejected.why: While the patient received trastuzumab, the presence of a distinct mass lesion is more indicative of a metastatic process than neurotoxicity.

rejected.label: Breast cancer
rejected.why: Breast cancer is the primary diagnosis, but it does not directly explain the new neurological symptoms and findings.
